decisions.reason: Hosting the marketing site on a subdomain does not change the selected Basic Webflow plan or the cheapest-plan selection rule.
The candidate already requires the root domain to continue serving the existing product; placing the separate marketing site on a subdomain leaves that requirement unchanged.
The marketing site's hosting domain does not change the dealer-login button placement or destination URL.
The subdomain decision does not change the Loom recording format or its site-editing instruction goal.
The hosting location does not alter the requirement to transfer the Webflow website to the client's workspace.
The subdomain decision does not change the early-access button's navigation to the contact page and form.
The marketing site's domain type does not change the configured recipients or delivery behavior for form submissions.
Hosting the landing page on a subdomain does not change its content composition, image quantity, or screenshot-selection policy.
The subdomain decision does not change the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
